From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>

Subject: Initial phone screen — availability windows for Rajiv Menon

Hi Rajiv,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer (L3) role and for the materials you submitted — I had a quick look and would love to set up a 30-minute initial phone screen with our hiring manager.

Could you confirm availability for any of these windows next week? I’ve listed times in IST and PST to make it easier:

- Tue 24 Nov — 10:00–11:00 IST (20:30–21:30 PST)
- Tue 24 Nov — 14:00–15:00 IST (00:30–01:30 PST)
- Wed 25 Nov — 09:30–10:30 IST (19:00–20:00 PST)

If none of those work, please tell me two 30-minute slots that do (and your timezone). We’ll aim for a 30-minute screen focused on background, recent work, and a quick technical discussion.

I’ve cc’d Dylan (hiring manager) and Lauren (recruiter support). I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time. Attached: brief JD and I’ll add the ics invite when confirmed.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: SWE-L3-JD.pdf (job description, 230 KB)

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@gmail.com>

Hi Maya,

Thanks — excited about the opportunity. I’m based in Bangalore (IST). Of the windows you proposed, the first on Tue 24 Nov at 10:00 IST works best for me.

If that fills up, I can also do: Wed 25 Nov between 09:00–11:00 IST.

Please confirm and I’ll accept the invite.

Best,
Rajiv Menon
rajiv.menon@gmail.com | +91 98765 43210
